newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tem Fat Hing Fung says pref div HK$0.151.
newsitem.headline: Tem Fat Hing Fung says pref div HK$0.151.

text.p: Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd declared a preference dividend of HK$0.151 per limited voting convertible cumulative redeemable preference share for the period of June 30 to December 30, 1996, the same as a year earlier.
The amount of the dividend payable per share is calculated at six percent on the notional value of HK$5.0 per preference share for the dividend period over a 365-day year.
The dividend is payable on December 31 and books close December 17.
Tem Fat Hing Fung is a bullion, jewellery and property company.
